question: Kajli Teej is the cultural festival of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kajli Teej** is a prominent cultural festival celebrated in the Indian state of Rajasthan.
 
• It is particularly celebrated with great enthusiasm in the city of **Bundi**.
 
• The festival is dedicated to **Goddess Parvati** and is observed by women for the well-being of their husbands.
 
• The celebration includes a grand procession of the goddess, traditional folk music, dance performances, and various cultural activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan**

 
 
• Rajasthan, meaning "Land of Kings," is India's largest state by area, located in the northwest part of the country.
 
• The state is known for its rich cultural heritage, majestic forts, palaces, and vibrant festivals.
 
• Some of the other famous festivals of Rajasthan include **Pushkar Fair, Desert Festival, Gangaur, and Mewar Festival**.
 
• Rajasthan is home to the Thar Desert and is known for its traditional Rajasthani cuisine, colorful attire, and handicrafts.
 
 
 
• **Kajli Teej Festival**
 
 
• It is celebrated on the third day of the Krishna Paksha (waning phase of the moon) in the Hindu month of Bhadrapada.
 
• The festival symbolizes the reunion of Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva after a long period of penance by Parvati.
 
• Women dress in their best traditional attire, apply mehendi (henna) on their hands, and participate in the Teej procession.
 
• The procession features beautifully decorated palanquins, camels, and folk artists performing traditional dances and music.
